Commentary.Commentary: South Africa won't be happy with the finish, but won't exactly be too disappointed either. 240 is chaseable, provided they pace the chase well. Everyone did a good job with the ball, barring Steyn who got taken for runs. And besides Tahir, who was economical, everyone got their name in the wickets column. The second half is set up for an exciting one. Not losing early wickets will be the key for the Proteas, and subsequently, just the opposite for the touring side. Join us on the other side of the break for all the action.

A fighting score on the board for Pakistan? Could just be. Another vital cameo from Imad Wasim might prove to be all the difference in this series decider. Being put into bat, the visitors lost the in-form Imam early, but post that came two solid stands involving Zaman. The half centurion threaded 56 and 44 with Babar and Hafeez respectively after getting a reprieve on 20, but he couldn't go on to score a big one. Wickets fell at regular intervals as the middle order couldn't last, but once again Wasim came to the rescue with his 31-ball 47, seeing his side to 240.
SIX!!! Wham! Finishes the innings off in style. Full on off and middle, Wasim clears out his front leg and whacks it over long off for a maximum. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 240/8 FROM THEIR 50 OVERS.
Full on off, Wasim lofts it over mid off. The batsmen run the first one hard and comes back for the second. Good running.
FOUR! Edge but Pakistan will take those. Bouncer outside off, the southpaw goes for a pull but gets a top edge to it. No worries there for him as he still gets the desired result. That's a boundary.
Back of a length on middle and off, Wasim pulls it towards deep mid-wicket but refuses to take the single. Afridi comes and then goes back.
Length delivery outside off, Wasim throws kitchen sink at it but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, Wasim hits it to deep point and does not take a single.
Full outside off and for the fourth time in a row, Shaheen fails to put bat on ball.
Bouncer outside off, Shaheen this time attempts a pull but once again  fails to connect.
Shorter in length outside off, Shaheen tries to hit it over third man but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, Afridi tries to hit it but misses.
Back of a length outside off, Imad punches it to deep point and takes a single.

SIX! Welcomes Steyn with a maximum. Off cutter fuller in length, Wasim reads that and heaves it over long on for a maximum. Trust me fast bowler's don't hate anything more than being hit for a six especially by a tailender.
Accurate bumper angling in on leg, Afridi barely manages to duck under it.
Shaheen Afridi walks in at number 10.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Rabada with an unplayable delivery. Fires in the yorker on off stump, too good for Amir who can't do anything about it. The off stump is taken for a walk and that's another Pakistan wicket down. Can they get to 250 at least? Need to if they want something competitive on the board.
Good length delivery which Amir fails to make connection with.
Wasim once again pulls it away. This time down towards fine leg for a run.
Cutting back in from around off, catches Amir on the pads and lobs towards point. A leg bye is stolen.
Short of a length delivery angling in, the pull is helped behind square leg for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Wasim pushes it to long on and keeps the strike for the start of next over.
Back of a length outside off, Wasim opens the face of the bat and guides it wide of the fielder at third man which allows them to get a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Wasim tries to play but misses.

In the air but safe. Shorter in length, Wasim pulls it but it hits high on his bat. The ball goes  high towards deep mid-wicket. It is wide of the fielder and falls short of him. Meanwhile Imad comes back for the second.
Full around off, Imad hits it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery outside off, Amir cuts it to point and rotates the strike.
Fuller around off, Mohammad pushes it towards cover for a run.
Full toss outside off, Amir misses his shot.
Slower delivery on a length, Amir once again tries to cut but gets beaten by the lack of pace in it.
Good length delivery outside off, Amir punches it towards deep cover and gets a couple.
On off in good length, Amir does well to block it.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Wasim flicks it away to fine leg for a single.
Kagiso Rabada back into the attack.
Shaping away from around off, punched towards cover-point for a run.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, the umpire signals a wide.
Drives this full delivery through to long on and gets to the other end.
Short ball, a touch straight in line, pulled through to deep square leg for a single.
Top edge but safe. Back of a length around off, Amir swings his bat, gets a thick edge and it goes down to third man. One run to the total.
Backs away to this length ball on the stumps and knocks it down to long on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide! Bowls this down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
On a length outside off, cut straight to the fielder at point.
Wide! Down the leg side on good length, Amir tries to flick but misses it. Quinton de Kock goes up in appeal but the umpire not only turns him down but also signals it as wide.
Mohammad Amir is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Shadab Khan is a goner. Pakistan lose their 7th wicket. Back of a length delivery, Khan tries to pull that but he is a bit early on his shot and the ball goes towards mid-wicket. Rassie van der Dussen there times his jump to perfection and catches it with both his hands.
On middle and leg, flicked away towards square leg for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Khan punches it to the off side for a single.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Wasim pulls it away after charging down the track for a single.

FOUR! Not the most convincing shot but gets the desired result. Full on middle, Wasim tries to loft it over mid off. He gets an edge to it and his left hand comes off the bat. The ball still goes over mid off and beats the chasing fielder to the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Imad tries to cut but gets a top edge. The ball falls short of the fielder at third man for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, Wasim comes down the track and pulls it away through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter in length, Shadab comes down the track and hits it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Shadab tries to guide it to third man with a straight bat but misses it. Khan is living dangerously here.
Once again outside off, Khan tries to cut it again but misses it this time. The ball misses the outside edge by just a whisker.
Length delivery outside off, Shadab cuts it to the fielder at point.

FOUR! Edged and away! The googly outside off, Imad Wasim plays away from the body, gets a thick edge and it flies past Amla at first slip. He dives low to his left but can't get to it. The ball races away behind for a boundary. Tahir is also through with his spell. 10-0-36-0.
A loopy and high full toss, kind of takes Shadab by surprise. He can only manage to hit it down to long off for one.
Outside off again, cut to the man at point this time.
Short and wide outside off, cut behind point, past the diving fielder for a couple of runs.
Comes half-forward to this fullish length ball and pushes it to the covers.
Quicker through the air, around off, it's kept out from the back foot.
Going away from around off, a length delivery, Imad stays back, opens the face and steers it to backward point. Pretorius is done for the innings, he finishes with figures of 10-1-46-2.
Back of a length around off, Wasim works it down in front of square leg. Wants the single but is sent back in time.
A hint of swing, coming in on a fuller length, Shadab whips this through square leg and crosses over.
Good length ball around off, run down but straight to short third man.
Angling across from a good length, around off, Wasim dabs it with an open face to point and changes ends.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, Shadab taps it down behind point and takes a quick single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Khan drives it through mid on and keeps the strike for the start of the next over.
On the pads, Wasim flicks it to the on side to get off the mark.
Floated on off, pushed straight to the fielder at mid-off.
Flighted on middle, Khan drives it to long on and gets a single.

NOT OUT! Good review by Shadab Khan. He lives to see another day. Tossed up delivery on middle, Khan tries to sweep but misses it completely. It hits him on his belly and the South African players go up in appeal and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Shadab has a discussion with Imam and goes for the review. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be going over the top and Pakistan retain their review. Tahir is having a bad day. He just cannot get a wicket. First loses the review when umpire turns it down and now the umpire signals it out but Hawk Eye denies him.
Flighted on the pads, Shadab plays it back to the bowler.

OUT! Shoaib Malik departs! Crucial wicket for South Africa. Length delivery on middle, Shadab flicks it through mid-wicket. Malik wants the second but Shadab sends him back. Dale Steyn does not quite realize the confusion and throws it to the bowler. Malik returns to the keeper's end but the throw from Pretorius is too good as de Kock quickly takes off the bails. It is referred upstairs but replays do not save Malik. Big wicket for South Africa as Malik was accelerating.
Run out? Looks like Shoaib Malik is just short of his crease.
Good length delivery on middle, Malik defends towards the leg side and takes a quick single.
Length delivery on middle, Khan guides it towards third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Malik guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery on off, the skipper keeps it out.
Short outside off, Malik cuts it through point where Andile Phehlukwayo does well to stop it.
Floated on off, Shoaib drives it towards backward point. The fielder at point does well. He dives to his left and saves a certain boundary. Malik only gets a run.

Dropped. Quicker leg spinner on middle, Khan comes down the track and tries to drive it through cover. The ball misses the outside edge and hits de Kock on his pad and goes towards on side for a single. Tahir goes up in air thinking it was a dropped chance. The umpire though signals it as bye. The replays show there was a slight outside edge.
Looped up on off, Shadab guides it to the fielder at point.
Lands it on off, Khan pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Flighted on off and middle, Khan chooses to defend it.
Tossed up on off, Malik pushes it to long on and gets off the strike.
Length delivery around off, Khan cuts it wide of the fielder at deep point and gets a brace.
Once again bowls it on length, Shadab punches it off the back foot straight to the fielder.
Length delivery on off, Khan hits it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Malik guides it to third man for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, Malik blocks it away.
Full on middle and leg, Khan pushes it to mid on and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Shorter and punished. Back of a length on middle and leg, Malik rocks onto his back foot and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary. Tahir was asking it to be punished.
Floated on off, Khan pushes it to cover and rotates the strike.
Full toss. Tahir is lucky there as Khan drives it straight to the fielder at cover.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Malik pulls it away towards square leg and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Shoaib watchfully blocks it off his front foot.
Leg spinner tossed up on off, Malik defends it.
Short delivery around off, Shadab isn't in full control, but he top edges the pull over mid-wicket. The batsmen take two as the fielder in the deep mops it up.
Outside off on a length, dabbed to point with an open face.
Bouncer angling in on leg, with a little swivel Malik helps the pull down to fine leg for a run.
Good length ball cutting back in, worked wide of mid on for one.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, blocked back down the track with a straight bat.
Short of a good length outside off, Malik rises on his toes and taps it away on the off side for a single.
Flighted on middle and leg, Shoaib pushes it to long on and keeps the strike for the start of next over.
Tossed up on middle, Malik carefully defends it off his front foot.
Shorter in length around off, Khan cuts it towards point and takes a quick single.
Slow on middle and leg, Shadab pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Flighted on off, Khan hits it straight. Tahir dives to his left to stop the ball. He gets his hand to it but cannot stop it. Luckily it goes to the fielder at mid off.
Tossed up on off, Malik pushes it to cover-point and takes a run.
Slightly fuller on middle and leg, pushed to the fielder at mid on.
Back of a length on off, Shadab taps it back to the bowler.
Length delivery around off, Khan pushes the ball straight to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery on off, Shadab blocks it off his back foot.
On a length on middle and off, Khan starts off his innings by watchfully defending it.
Shadab Khan to bat next.

OUT! Pretorius strikes straightaway as soon as he is reintroduced into the attack. Back of a length delivery outside off, Rizwan comes charging down the track. He tries to attack the new bowler immediately but the plan backfires as he gets an outside edge and the ball goes to Quinton de Kock. He takes a very simple catch at a comfortable height behind the stumps.
Dwaine Pretorius back on.
Flighted delivery on leg, Rizwan sweeps it towards fine leg. The batsmen rotate the strike.
Full on off, Mohammad drives it to covers.
Tossed up on middle, Mohammad defends off the back foot.
Floated on middle, Malik drives it towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Rizwan flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Rizwan flicks it towards short mid-wicket. It was in the air for a while but it was safe.
Drinks break.
Full on middle and leg, Rizwan flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, Rizwan plays it to mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Rizwan keeps it out.
Full on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Full on off, Rizwan plays it to covers.

APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Good length delivery on leg, Rizwan looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Hawk Eye shows it was missing the stumps.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Malik flicks it away straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On the pads, Rizwan flicks it away to square leg for a single.

SAFE! Quick leg spinner pitching on leg. It does not turn as much as Rizwan expected. He tries to defend it but gets hit on the front pad. The players appeal and the umpire turns it down. Quinton de Kock, Faf du Plessis and Imran Tahir have a brief discussion and decide to go for the review. Hawk Eye shows the ball was going over the top of the stumps and South Africa lose their review.
Review time. It's for an lbw decision against Mohammad Rizwan. Doesn't look too convincing though.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Rizwan defends it.
Shorter outside off, Malik cuts it away to point for a single.
Tossed up leg spinner pitching on leg, Shoaib taps it back to the bowler.
A little too straight in line, wristed away into the leg side for no run.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, blocked out from inside the crease.
FOUR! Gives the charge and gets the desired result. Rizwan jumps out of his crease to this length delivery around off and smashes it past mid off to find the fence.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Stays right behind the line of this fullish length ball and defends.
Bumper just outside the line of off stump, Malik rises on his toes and mistimes the slap-pull towards mid on.
Rock solid in defense. The googly around off, it spins in, Rizwan picks it up and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter, quicker and on off, Rizwan goes back and keeps it out.
Loopy leg break outside off, Malik goes with the spin as he drives it through the covers for one.
Tossed up on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
A bit quicker through the air, around off, blocked.
Imran Tahir to roll his arm over.
Works this away to deep square leg and keeps strike with a single.
Play and a miss! Back of a length delivery rising off the deck, well outside off, Rizwan tries to cut but fails to make connection.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. No run taken.
Goes full this time, pitches it outside off, Rizwan drives it right to the mid off fielder.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed to point from inside the crease.
Fraction straight in line from Andile, Shoaib Malik works it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length delivery around off, Rizwan drives it off the inner portion down the track.
Gets off strike with a single. Short ball banged in, Malik awkwardly fends it away past the diving square leg fielder for a single.
Wide! Angled down the leg side, Shoaib tries tickling it fine down the leg side but misses.
Low inswinging full toss from Rabada, the batter plays it off the inner half in front of square leg and comes back for the second.
Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, another defensive shot on offer.
Shortish delivery, banged in outside off, Malik hops, goes across and defends it down on the off side.
Full length delivery just outside off, Malik leans across, gets behind the line and defends.
Length delivery on leg, Rizwan defends it to the leg side.
Mohammad Rizwan is the new man in.

OUT! Fakhar Zaman departs! Big wicket for South Africa. Second wicket for Andile Phehlukwayo. Short of a length delivery on leg, Zaman looks to pull but gets a top edge on this one. It goes towards fine leg where Imran Tahir takes a good catch before the rope. He signals out to the umpire at first instance. It is referred upstairs. The third umpire wants to check whether the foot was touching the ropes. Replays show that he is just fine on this one. The umpires are checking for the front foot no ball. It is fine. Zaman was looking good, but he could and should have done much better given he got a reprieve and was quite set.
Good length delivery on off, Zaman looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery on off, Zaman looks to tap but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full on middle and leg, Malik flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Malik defends off the back foot.
This short of a length delivery is cracked but straight to the point fielder. End of the over.
Behind a length, close to the off stick, blocked down with soft hands on the off side.
FOUR! That's a really good shot. Short ball into the body, Zaman plays this with complete control. Swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Around the wicket again with Zaman on strike, full and well outside off, the opener drives it to the man at extra cover.
Over the wicket to Malik. Rabada keeps it around off, on a good length, it's played off the outer half down to third man for a run.
Starts off from around the wicket and pitches it on a length around off, Zaman pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Kagiso Rabada is brought back on to bowl.
Length delivery on middle, Zaman looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards the off side. The batsmen take a run.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery on leg, Zaman looks to pull but gets glove on it. It goes towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Malik taps it towards third man for a single.
Length delivery on leg, Malik flicks it to the leg side.
WIDE! Bowls a bouncer down leg, Malik does well to duck under it.
Full on middle and leg, Malik drives it towards mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Full on middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
A short ball, pulled through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman has played it to the point region for a couple.

OUT! Big wicket for South Africa in the context of the game. Short ball does the trick. This is on leg, Hafeez comes down the track to pull but gets an edge behind the keeper. It goes towards de Kock who takes a comfortable catch to his left. Pakistan lose their third wicket. The hosts needed this wicket badly because this partnership was looking good, worth 44.
Length delivery on off, Hafeez defends off the front foot.
THAT HAS HURT. On a length around off, Zaman pushes it towards covers and sets off for a quick single. The fielder returns a sharp throw at the bowler's end but hits Zaman instead, on his right arm.
FOUR! Good shot. Length delivery on leg, Zaman flicks it through square leg where Pretorius runs to his right, puts a dive to stop it but it goes through him to the fence.
Andile Phehlukwayo introduced into the attack.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Poor effort from South Africa again and FAKHAR REACHES HIS HALF CENTURY. Full and around off, Zaman drives it straight back down the ground. Mid on gets across, parries it to Tahir backing up from mid off but he overruns to his left and slips. All the way to the fence.
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a run.
Full and around off, pushed through the covers for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Willem Mulder into the attack now.
A length ball around off, nicely pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, punched through point for a single.
Another rash shot. Similar ball, Zaman tries to slash again, does not move his feet again and misses again.
The break nearly does Fakhar in. A length ball around off, Zaman plays an 'I-don't-care-who-you-are' type shot, going at it flat-footed and misses.
A bit of a delay. There is a cloth hanging around the sightscreen, which is causing an inconvenience to Fakhar. We wait for it to get sorted out. Ready now.

FOUR! This guy continues to find the boundaries. His 6th in 53 balls. A length ball outside off, Zaman punches this down the ground, splitting mid on and mid off to perfection. Good geometry student, perfecting the art of bisection.
Short and outside off, Hafeez jumps to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
A short ball, at the body, pulled towards long leg for one.
Another long hop, pulled through square leg for a run.
A short ball, around off, Hafeez mistimes his pull towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A length ball outside off, Zaman looks to push but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A single taken.

DRINKS BREAK. Good passage of play. South Africa will feel that they are not far from a wicket as long as Fakhar is playing while Pakistan will be happy with Zaman's love for big games. The longer he plays, greater is the chance of Pakistan getting a big score.
IN THE AIR... SAFE! Good ball from Pretorius. A short ball, at a good pace around off, Hafeez looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes wide of mid-wicket, near square leg. Two runs taken.
A bouncer, around off, Hafeez sways away from the line.
A short ball again, punched through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Comes down the track and hits it straight to mid on.
Outside off, punched behind point for a run.
Similar ball, nicely blocked out.
Full and pretty straight, watchfully blocked out.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Around off, solidly defended.
FOUR! AMAZING! What a welcome to Steyn. Full and outside off, Hafeez leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Dale Steyn returns. 5-0-36-1 so far.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Full and around off, Zaman pushes at it and gets it past mid off. Down the ground and to the fence. 10 from that over.
A length ball outside off, Hafeez looks to defend but the ball kicks off the surface, takes the outside edge and goes behind point. A single taken.
A short ball, pulled behind square leg, with a nice swivel, for a brace.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for a couple.
A yorker to end the over, Hafeez digs it out.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Full on off, swinging in late, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
A short ball, pulled towards long leg for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.

SAFE BY A YARD. Gets the extra run as well. So a couple to get off the mark. Outside off, Hafeez tapped it towards point and set off for a single. Faf du Plessis quickly got across to his right and had a shy at the bowler's end and hit the stumps. The Proteas appealed but the umpire waited to see whether the ball had become dead. He waited till mid on got across to his right and the batsmen took another single. Then he referred it upstairs. But no harm done.
Are we in for a run out? Hafeez could be in trouble here. Faf du Plessis has rocketed a direct hit at the bowler's end. Referred upstairs...
In comes the Professor. Mohammad Hafeez walks in at number 4, replacing Azam.

OUT! BOWLED AROUND HIS LEGS! The leg stump has gone for a toss. Bowled with a scrambled seam, in line of the stumps, Babar walks across his stumps but gets way too across. He looks to flick but the ball just shoots through. Perhaps there was a odd shortage of bounce but to be honest, he has missed a pretty straight ball. Waste of a wicket. He was looking in good flow.
Dropped short, pulled away for a run.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Around middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Full and around middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Ball strikes the batsman on his hand, it could be nasty.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
FOUR! Lovely shot again, Overpitched from Rabada, Azam drives it straight back down the ground, towards long on.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Pushes this towards point for a run.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Here comes Dwaine Pretorius.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total. 54/1 IN POWERPLAY 1.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! 50 UP FOR PAKISTAN! Full and around middle, Zaman drives it straight down the ground for a boundary!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
A short ball, around off, Zaman looks to pull but miscues it over mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE. A bouncer, way too high, Azam ducks.
A short ball, outside off, Babar rises with the bounce but is hit on the higher part of the bat.
Good ball! The off cutter from Steyn, on a length, Azam looks to defend but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge. Lands short of de Kock.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Outside off, played towards point. A MAIDEN from Rabada, could have been a wicket maiden.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A bouncer from Rabada, showing his frustration, FZ ducks.

EDGED, DROPPED! Dear o dear. Now now now. Memories being revived. Remember a certain Champions Trophy Final? Fakhar Zaman the batsman. Jasprit Bumrah the bowler. A dismissal off a no ball. Fakhar makes India pay. Will South Africa have to face a similar fate? Schoolboy stuff, to be honest. Full and outside off, Zaman goes hard at it, without moving his feet. Gets a thick outside edge as a result and it flies straight to Hashim Amla at first slip. It goes in but then pops out. No reason to explain why. Just in and out.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.

FOUR! SWEET! No stopping this one! Similar balls, the last 2, but while Babar missed out on the previous delivery, this time he doesn't. Comes forward and drives it straight back past the bowler with a lovely pose. Mid on is nowhere in the frame to even try and chase it. 14 from the over! Do Pakistan have the momentum now?
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Full and wide outside off, Fakahr punches this through the covers for a boundary again!
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Zaman reaches out and squeezes it over backward point for a boundary!
Landed outside off, angling away, Babar dabs it towards third man for a single.
Dropped short, pulled straight to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Not the cleanest of strokes, but he will not mind. A short ball, down the leg side, Zaman swivels, looks to pull but the ball does not quite come onto the bat as quickly as he expected. The ball rolls off the bottom edge, through fine leg and races to the fence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Around off and middle, watchfully defended.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
Kagiso Rabada time. The experiment of opening with Imran Tahir has not yielded much results.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Around off, solidly defended.
Down the leg side, helped towards fine leg for one more.
Full and outside off, outswing, BA looks to flick but then the ball swings away late. An outside edge is induced which goes to third man. A run taken. Babar moves to 10 from just 5 balls.
FOUR! Babar is off to a flier but he is being given wings by the Saffas. Too straight from Steyn, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket. Acres of free space available there.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and around off, spinning away, BA looks to flick but the ball goes off the leading edge towards point. A run taken.
FOUR! SUBLIME! Bad ball but that does not take away the beauty of the shot. Another full toss from Tahir, Babar eases it through the covers and gets a boundary.
A full toss, on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.

Smart bowling. Putting the anticipation in the batsman's mind that this one is also going to be short, but this is a full ball. Zaman though, is ready for it and drives it through the covers. Three runs taken.

ON THE GRILLE! This is fast. This is furious. Steyn continues to pepper the batsmen with short stuff. This time it is Fakhar in the line of fire. Tries to fend but the ball goes off his vizor. Looks okay.
Babar Azam walks in at number 3, replacing Imam.

OUT! Caught! Steyn-gun strikes. Pakistan have lost their first pretty early. A short ball, around off, Imam looks to pull but the extra bounce does him in. A top edge is induced and the ball goes high in the air. Dwaine Pretorius circles under it at third man and takes a decent catch. Right start for the Saffas.
Another leave outside off, let through.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Outside off, pushed towards mid off now.
A loopy full toss outside off, Zaman lunges to flick but cannot get it past short mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed towards point.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Around off, pushed past the bowler towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, the googly first up, Imam pushes but misses.
Whoa! Imran Tahir to bowl with the second new ball! Bizarre and a bold move from Faf. Interesting...
Outside off, left alone. Inconsistent opener from the Steyn-gun.

IN TWO MINDS. Should I leave or should I go? On a length outside off, Imam looks to defend but then wants to let it go. Is late and the ball sneaks off the outside edge, wide of second slip towards third man. Just a single.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Outside off, around a good length, left alone.
FOUR! Bad line. Down the leg side, plenty of inswing, Imam just tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Full and around middle, swinging in, Imam looks to defend but the ball sneaks off the inside edge through mid-wicket. Two runs taken.

A bright sunny afternoon welcomes all of us as Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman stride out to the middle. Dale Steyn will begin proceedings with the first new ball. Imam to face. Two slips in place. Here we go!

TOSS - A very important one won by the Proteas, if social media is to be believed. Shoaib Malik has not called it correctly and Faf du Plessis says SOUTH AFRICA WILL CHASE. Interestingly, all the previous 4 ODIs have seen chasing sides win.

Time for the decider! Not many would have expected this. Pakistan won the first but then South Africa came back hard in the next two. And then, under a new captain, the Asian giants trounced the Proteas in the 4th ODI. This is the big stage now. Pakistan are settled, South Africa are not. What will happen today? Hello and a warm welcome to the fifth and final ODI between South Africa and Pakistan in Cape Town.
